data.name: Hiralal
data.gender_notes: Hiralal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hira means 'shining, radiant, or jewel'. Lal means 'red' or 'the one who removes sorrows'. Thus, Hiralal is the one who shines and removes sorrows. The name Hiralal carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hiralal usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in the darkness, illuminating the path for others.
data.etymology: Hiralal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hiralal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hiralal carries a rich cultural heritage, reflecting the values and beliefs deeply embedded in Hindu society. The suffix 'lal' could symbolize the god Lord Krishna, who is known as the remover of all sorrows. Hira represents the precious and divine energy within us, as well as an aspirational quality towards being multifaceted, like a precious jewel. The name is therefore significant in imparting qualities of strength, resilience, positivity, and divine protectorship.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Hiralal signifies the innate passion and energy within each individual, imbued with the divine qualities of radiance and compassion. The name is a reminder of the inner light that shines within us, inspiring hope, courage, and fortitude amidst life's trials and tribulations. The combination of Hira and Lal reflects the harmony between the spiritual and maternal aspects of one's soul, symbolizing the harmony that needs to exist between our spiritual aspirations and our grounding in compassion and love. Ultimately, Hiralal inspires an understanding that, even in times of darkness, the inner light and divine power within us continues to shine bright, illuminating our spiritual path and guiding us towards a fulfilled and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hiralal: Radiant Spirit, Ever-Smiling God. In the divine realm, Hiralal represents the pure joy and boundless energy of the divine, always shining and spreading happiness. His name encapsulates the essence of inner bliss and eternal optimism.

historical_references.reference: Hiralal was a celebrated poet in the medieval period of India, contributing significantly to the Bhakti movement with his works. He was a contemporary of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and is believed to have been born in the 15th century in the region of Bengal, India.

Hiralal was a prominent Hindu scholar and philosopher in ancient India, known for his extensive works on various aspects of Jainism and Hinduism. He lived during the Gupta period and is considered a crucial figure in the development of Indian philosophy.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Hiralal, originally a Hindu name meaning 'beloved to Hari' (Vishnu), is gaining modern usage across various platforms. On social media, individuals with the name Hiralal have created profiles on popular platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram, using their unique identity to build a personal brand. In the business world, Hiralal can be seen as the name of restaurants, clothing brands, and even tech startups, reflecting a fusion of traditional Indian values and contemporary entrepreneurship. Lastly, in the context of modern naming trends, Hiralal is increasingly being given as a name to newborn babies, signifying a desire to preserve and celebrate cultural heritage while embracing the future.
